page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3s.4xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance operates under the KVM hypervisor. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power without resource contention from neighboring virtual machines.

The defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 95348 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, enabling substantial data throughput. No GPUs are included in this hardware profile, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive local HDD capacity and balanced compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core, this instance is designed for storage-heavy workloads. It is highly cost-efficient for applications requiring large-scale sequential data access, such as distributed file systems, big data analytics, data warehousing, and cold storage archives. The use of HDD storage rather than SSDs represents a qualitative tradeoff, prioritizing massive capacity and cost-per-gigabyte efficiency over high random IOPS.
